_comment: Backend line-coverage floor. A ratchet, not a target: scripts/coverage_gate.py
fails when the FULL backend suite (backend/tests: unit + integration + guardian)
measures BELOW this number. It never fails for being above it, and it never
raises itself -- raising it is a deliberate edit. It may not be lowered without
a `Ratchet-Exempt: <why>` line in the commit message.
Measured 2026-09-19 at commit abf97db and again, unchanged, at a0e4951 (which adds
packages/causal-core and leaves backend/ alone). coverage.py via pytest-cov,
Python 3.12.3, `--cov=src`, so backend/mcp_server is not in the denominator:
Set at the full-suite measurement rounded down to one decimal.
Why this replaced `--cov-fail-under=80` in backend/pyproject.toml: that flag
applied to every pytest invocation, so the CI unit job (unit tests only,
~75%) could never pass, and running a single test file failed on coverage.
What this number is NOT: evidence that any causal number is right. 560 tests
pass and none of them asserts an estimate against a known ground truth.
Coverage says which lines ran, not whether what they computed is true.
